_comment: Passive talents that modify the EQ spell pack (tools/eq_spell_pack.json). Consumed by tools/build_client_patch.py alongside the spell pack. Each talent is a single-rank talent_dbc chain (IDs 90001+, above the real Talent.dbc's max of 2285) whose one rank is a passive spell (IDs 994001+) carrying up to 3 native SpellMod aura effects (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER=108 / SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER=107), targeted at exactly one EQ spell via SpellFamilyName=220 + a classmask bit matching that spell's `family_bit` in eq_spell_pack.json (verified against src/server/game/Spells/SpellInfo.cpp's IsAffected() and SpellAuraEffects.cpp's IsAffectedOnSpell()). 'op' is the raw SPELLMOD_* enum from src/server/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h. IMPORTANT, verified the hard way: only a subset of SpellModOps actually apply to a fresh, one-off cast (checked every ApplySpellMod() call site in src/server/game/Spells/Spell.cpp, Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp, Entities/Player/Player.cpp) - DURATION(1), RANGE(5), CASTING_TIME(10), COOLDOWN(11), DAMAGE(0)/DOT(22) [these two verified via Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone/SpellHealingBonusDone, which is also how a periodic HEAL's tick amount is modified - DOT covers both DoTs and HoTs], COST(14). SPELLMOD_EFFECT1/2/3(3/12/23) do NOT work here despite existing in the enum - AuraEffect::ApplySpellMod (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:813) only uses them to recalculate an aura that is ALREADY a passive/permanent aura on the caster (aura->IsPassive()||aura->IsPermanent()), which none of our spells are (they're timed, targeted, one-off casts) - so any non-damage/heal aura magnitude (a slow %, a flat stat bonus, a resource-regen amount, a CC's own strength) has NO generic native modifier path for a fresh cast. Every talent below is designed around only the verified ops; several base spells in eq_spell_pack.json were given an extra DORMANT effect slot (EffectBasePoints stored as -1, i.e. true zero) whose *type* is already a real SCHOOL_DAMAGE/PERIODIC_DAMAGE/PERIODIC_HEAL effect so a talent's flat DAMAGE/DOT modifier can 'activate' it (0 + delta = delta) without inventing a new mechanic. 'special':'skeleton_buff' is the one talent that isn't a SpellMod at all - see lua/SpellDraft/spelldraft_eq_talents.lua (buffing a summoned Guardian's own stats isn't reachable through the caster-side SpellMod system either, verified against SpellEffects.cpp's EffectSummonType). Talents are NOT added to LOCKED_TALENTS - purchasable with ordinary Talent Points. Avatar (pure Strength/Agility/Attack Power stat effects, no damage/heal effect, already using all 3 of its effect slots) has no non-duration lever available under these constraints and so gets exactly one talent instead of four - flagged to the user rather than silently faked.
